svg.title: GPipe pipeline schedule timeline for N=4 stages, comparing M=4 and M=8 microbatches, showing the bubble shrink predicted by the corrected formula
svg.desc: Technical diagram for Programming the H100; see the adjacent chapter text for the full explanation.

g.text: GPipe Pipeline Schedule — Bubble Shrinks as Microbatch Count (M) Grows (N=4 stages)
1F1B interleaves these same F/B blocks per stage (forward, then immediately backward, alternating)
instead of all-forward-then-all-backward — same bubble fraction, but it never needs to hold all
M microbatches' activations live at once.
